set.body: Add lisa_bilateral(), is_lisa_filter(), and a slow audited bilateral_filter3d() reference implementation. Defaults should match LISA-style settings: radius 2 voxels, sigma_space 2, sigma_range 2, n_iter 2, scale from early null maps. Prioritize deterministic behavior and mask-normalized neighborhoods before compiled speed.
set.title: LISA: bilateral filter specification and reference backend
